svg.title: Bootstrap, Scaffolding, and Local Safety Boundary

g.text: Bootstrap, Scaffolding, and Local Safety Boundary
Open dedicated folder; paste setup request / guide link
Configure supported MCP client; preserve other settings
Request only required reload; verify after loading
Correct connection address / client settings; retry
Verify selected writable folder scope (no writes yet)
[Folder missing, read-only or outside selected scope]
Open an in-scope folder before local writes
Run setup prompt after prerequisites pass
Get latest workspace template and application kit
Safely scaffold selected root; preserve existing files
Write local state and managed-file hashes
Report readiness; ask for CV or confirmed profile facts
Add private CV, evidence, voice, job files
Safe next action; no private file content sent
MCP supplies generic public resources and reads only the manifest supplied by the local SOP.
Original files remain local; selected writing or CV/JD text can be sent for requested checks later.
Client registration and folder permissions are separate; unresolved prerequisites stop setup.
